comment: 2D affine correction applied to throw targets in BB-local frame. Maps desired-landing → commanded-target so that, when fed through solve_throw_local + BB hardware, the ball lands at the desired position. Z is not corrected (matrix is 2D).

provenance.sessions: 1+2 (10 throws to an 8x8 grid of 800x800 mm, 54 reachable targets after exclusions)
provenance.computed_by: least-squares fit of target_pos → measured_mean, inverted to give command = A @ desired_landing
provenance.warning: Pre-FK-fix data: sessions 1+2 were before (a) QTM-based BB calibration, (b) global_to_bb_frame rotation fix, (c) FK with s/d/l offsets, and (d) the pitch_z_offset_mm fix from commit 455cf06. Our current code already corrects for these, so this matrix may OVER-CORRECT. Treat as a starting point only; run a fresh calibration grid and re-derive when possible.
provenance.z_caveat: Calibration was done at BB-local z ≈ +750 mm (above BB origin). Targets at other heights (e.g. the cone at z ≈ -597 mm BB-local) may have different bias not captured here.
